messages:
Liam: FYI — SparrowEdge reached out to run a joint throughput vs power validation next week. They want steady-state numbers and a short thermal profile for our marketplace listing. Can we scope?
Anna: Ack. Which models and instance types are they expecting?
SparrowOps: Hey all — SparrowEdge here. Primary targets are LLM-small (8k context) and a 4k chat model variant. Hardware: SparrowA1 (8x custom accelerators). We can provide JTAG logs and power rails telemetry. Constraints: tests must run under our lab safety window Wed-Fri.
Josh: Got it. Proposal: two matrices — 1) single-stream latency/throughput at 1/2/4/8 concurrent streams, 2) long-run thermal profile (30m ramps at 50/75/100% sustained load). Use the same input corpus and fixed seed.
Sophia: +1. For reproducibility, we'll use the infra harness `redwood-infer-run` with pinned model hashes. Example run command:```bash
redwood-infer-run --model x:sha256:abcd1234 --hardware sparrow-a1 --concurrency 4 --seq-len 2048 --duration 1800 --collect nvml,counters,thermal
```
Sophia: CSV export header we'll use: `timestamp,wall_ms,requests,completed,qps,lat_p50,lat_p95,lat_p99,power_w,board_temp_c,cpu_temp_c,mem_usage_mb`
Liam: Can the Sparrow team expose instantaneous power and the board-level thermal sensor at 5s granularity? That greatly helps steady-state detection.
SparrowOps: Yes — we can stream `power.watts` and `thermal.board` at 5s. We'll also attach the lab safety log. We can't give HBM-level traces due to IP, but high-level counters OK.
Josh: For metrics, let's define steady-state as the 10m window with <3% qps variance. We'll report avg power and qps plus perf-per-watt = qps / avg_power. Also include 95th-latency and p99 tail.
Anna: Who's owning the marketplace "performance badge" criteria? PM asked that results map to one of three tiers. I can draft thresholds but need input on realistic numbers.
Sophia: I can run a dry run on our staging cluster today to validate the harness and dataset. Will push logs to the shared folder: `gs://redwood-partner/sparrowedge/1738123456-dryrun/`
bench-bot: dry-run complete — 1738123456-dryrun. Artifacts: `throughput.csv` (4.2k lines), `nvml.tsv`, `runtime.log`. No OOMs, no thermal throttles seen in 30m.
Josh: Nice. @SparrowOps — can you confirm the lab window and provide a contact for on-call when we execute the full run? We'll need someone to triage AVR alarms if thermal crosses threshold.
SparrowOps: Wed 09:00-17:00 PT works. On-call: @maria.ops (cc: +1). We'll notify when rigs are staged.
Liam: Plan for next steps: 1) Sophia does staging dry-run (today) 2) Anna drafts badge thresholds and announcement language (tomorrow) 3) Joint run Wed morning — we collect and produce a short one-pager with graphs and perf-per-watt numbers.
Anna: I'll start the one-pager template and include a small FAQ about methodology.
Sophia: After the run, let's schedule a 30m sync to walk through artifacts and decide which dataset to publish for the marketplace blurb.
Liam: Perfect. Thanks everyone — post any blockers here. :thumbsup:
